skins.name: Letters from Wessex
skins.content: A uniform from Victoria's Wessex Middle School, adapted by traditional Victorian designers. Centuries of rich heritage combines with excellent craftsmanship to make a light and comfortable outfit.
skins.quote: A blast from the middle school past.
